question.text: Within how many days of filing the draft offer document with SEBI must the issuer make a public announcement?

explanation.text: The Logic: Within 2 days of filing the draft offer document with SEBI, the issuer must make a public announcement in one English national daily, one Hindi national daily, and one regional language newspaper. The Trap: The 5-day or 7-day options sound plausible but are incorrect; the source specifies a tight 2-day window for the public announcement. Note: The announcement must appear across all three newspaper categories — English national, Hindi national, and regional — within the 2-day window.
